name: MCP Starter for Puch AI
description: A starter template for creating MCP servers that work with Puch AI, featuring ready-to-use tools for job searching and image processing. Includes examples for Bearer token authentication, OAuth integration with Google and GitHub, and demonstrates user-scoped data management.
